race.comment: SCENIC GEORGE (2) looks well placed to improve sharply second-up after a fair Ascot return in metro CL1 company, where he began awkwardly and was beaten three and a half lengths. He now finds an easier meeting, gets a 3kg claim and has enough 1000m substance to make this a winnable assignment. GOD'LL GETYA (4) brings the clearest last-start winning form, having put away Cartier Glow by just over two lengths in a Mdn over this track and trip, and his third-up fitness adds to the appeal. CALADAN (1) is the proven 1000m runner among the main hopes and went close here last start when beaten just under a length. Third-up now and can go one better. ALEBRIJE (3) ended last campaign with an issue, but draws well on resumption and a forward showing is on the cards. PRASUTAGUS (6) can run a better race first-up.
